name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – § 25 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 25. Calls on Türkiye and Israel to respect Syria’s territorial integrity and sovereignty and to immediately cease all attacks and incursions on and occupation of Syrian territory in full compliance with international law; condemns Israel’s provocative requests and military actions that put the state-building process and the 1974 agreement at risk; recalls that the European Union does not recognise Israel’s sovereignty over the occupied Golan Heights, in accordance with international law and United Nations Security Council Resolutions 242 and 497;
